question: Energy conversion in water pump is from ________ to ________.
solution:
The correct answer is** __Option 3__**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Energy conversion in water pump is from **electrical **to** mechanical.**

__
 
• An **electric motor** uses** electromagnetic induction** to convert **electrical energy** into** mechanical energy**.
 
• **Electric energy **is converted into **mechanical energy** by a **direct current (DC) motor**, and **mechanical energy **is converted into **electrical energy** by an **alternating current (AC) generator**.
 
• **The electric motor** is used as an important component in **electric fans, refrigerators, mixers, washing machines, computers, MP3 players, etc.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Dynamo -** A dynamo is an **electrical generator **that uses a **commutator** to generate **direct current**.
 
• **Inverter -** An **inverter converts direct current (DC) electricity** from sources such as batteries or fuel cells to **alternating current (AC)**.The **electricity **can be at any **voltage** required; in an instance, it can power **AC equipment **designed for mains operation or be** rectified** to produce** DC** at any **voltage** required.
 
• **Potentiometer -** A potentiometer is a device that we use to measure the **electromagnetic force** of the cell. **Potentiometers** operate on the Wheatstone bridge principle, which means no current flows through the meter.
